packet.title: Schematron as a front end to the XSLT AST (implementation)

body.p: After the owner's review of 7.27 (, ), after (the locations a validation keeps; both touch apps/sxml/), after 's suite exists (tests/schematron/, gate 6) and cli-4 (which holds apps/sxml/ and docs/CLI.md). Implements include/sxml/schematron.h as (revised) designs it, against ISO/IEC 19757-3:2025 (the owner's copy; cite clauses, copy no text); a change to the header needs a record first.

item.p: Owns:

new: src/schematron_internal.h (the index, the table of assertions and rules, the layout of a finding item), src/schematron_read.c (documents, sch:include, sch:extends href and sch:library, the index, the query binding: 's one place for the bindings sxml does not read, every error to the compile report sink), src/schematron_expand.c (the placeholder scan over the instance's and the schema's parameters, defaults, expansion segments), src/schematron_build.c (the stylesheet AST: variables and their scopes, groups, visit-each, from, #ANY, dynamic attribute values), src/schematron.c (the public API: compile, describe, validate, reports), src/schematron_svrl.c (SVRL from reports and the static table, Annex D);

changed: src/xslt.c and src/xslt_transform_internal.h (compile a given AST: the part of sxml_xslt_compile after reading; a compile report sink through reading and static analysis, "Compile errors"), include/sxml/xslt.h (additive: sxml_xslt_configuration.report_sink, sxml_schema_report_sink reused; a record of its own), src/xslt_read.c's and the static analysis' error paths that go on after an error, apps/sxml/command_transform.c and its tests (every compile error on its own line), the JavaScript compileStylesheet (reports on the error) and the book where it shows a stylesheet error, src/xslt_read.c and src/xslt_read_internal.h (read one foreign XSLT declaration into a given AST under a given parent, with extra namespace bindings);

tests: tests/schematron_test.c (reading, placeholders, each construct of the 2025 edition, error codes with their locations, several errors from one compile, the lifecycle under the counting allocator), small .sch fixtures in tests/schematron/, and a driver tests/schematron/driver/ (sxml-schematron-test, not shipped, as the XSD driver: the VEFA unit tests of EN 16931 and the differential test);

vendored test data in third_party/, pinned in tools/update-test-suites.sh (), none of it shipped: EN 16931's validation artefacts (ConnectingEurope/eInvoicing-EN16931, EUPL 1.2: src/ubl/schematron, src/cii/schematron, src/test), XRechnung's Schematron (itplr-kosit/xrechnung-schematron v2.6.0, Apache 2.0: src/validation/schematron and its test instances), SchXslt 1.10.1 (MIT, its 2.0/ directory; , item 6);
apps/sxml/command_validate.c, its tests in tests/cli/, and docs/CLI.md's validate section (, "The CLI");
the JavaScript package's Schematron API (bindings/javascript/src/index.ts, sxml_javascript_exports.c, sxml_javascript_full_exports.c, its tests; , "JavaScript");
a book chapter (docs/book/src/schematron.md and SUMMARY.md), with real output;
glossary terms it adds, LOG, its record.
Order, a commit after each step:

src/xslt.c: compile a given AST (no change in behaviour). 1b. The XSLT compile report sink: xslt.h, reading and static analysis go on after an error, sxml transform and JavaScript report them all. XT40 unchanged case by case (the null sink keeps today's first-error behaviour).
src/xslt_read.c: read one foreign declaration into a given AST. XT40 unchanged case by case after steps 1 and 2.
Read, inclusions (include, extends href, library), index and query binding (case ignored; none, xslt and xpath as 4.0), every error to the report sink, with unit tests.
Placeholders: the scan (whole name token, the instance's table then the schema's, abstract defaults, values not scanned again) and expansion segments (error offsets), with unit tests.

Build, compile and validate the third-edition constructs, with fixtures; variables and their scopes (, "Variables"); reports with both locations. 5b. The 2025 constructs, a fixture each: group, rules, visit-each (rule lets once per context node), severity and the error-finding rule (severity decides when present), dynamic flag, role and severity (variable references, AVTs), let/@as, phase from, when with #ANY, schematronEdition (any value, reported), the message context (6.3), expression rule contexts (with from, with documents, under #ANY).
Vendor EN 16931, XRechnung and SchXslt; the driver; gates 1 and 2.
SVRL; the differential test (gate 3).
The CLI (--schematron-param, --phase=#ANY). 9. JavaScript.
The book chapter.
Gates:

EN 16931: the UBL unit tests, 1,133 of 1,133 checks, and the CII unit tests, 9 of 9, pass with the rules compiled from the .sch sources (EN16931-UBL-validation.sch, EN16931-CII-validation.sch), counted as on 2026-10-28 (each test's rules in scope must or must not fire, with their counts).

Compile time: compiling EN16931-UBL-validation.sch takes well under a second in a release build (measured, with peak memory, and reported beside SchXslt's 10.5 s), within the library's default step bound (10^8 steps; compiling evaluates only static expressions), and each unit test validates within it too.

Differential: for the EN 16931 UBL and CII rule sets and XRechnung's UBL and CII rule sets, over their test instances, the set of (pattern, assertion id, kind, subject path) in sxml's reports equals the set of (id, kind, location) in the SVRL that SchXslt 1.10.1 running on sxml makes from the same .sch, and the fired rules (context, node) agree. A difference is fixed or explained in the record (a value that SchXslt scans again, a placeholder SchXslt matched by prefix, ), never reclassified (). SchXslt has no 2025 constructs: gate 6 covers them.

Errors in the .sch: each schematron:* code, and a syntax error in a test, in a rule context, in a sch:param value (an instance's, a schema's, a configured one) and in a foreign xsl:function, has a test of its file, line and column; one .sch with errors of several kinds gives all of them in one compile, in the C API, the CLI and JavaScript; a dynamic error in a test names its assertion's line.
Locations of findings: the instance's line and column in text, JSON and JavaScript reports, on an EN 16931 test instance.

The 2025 edition: 7.30's suite (tests/schematron/) passes, 100 % of its applicable cases, run by the driver; each construct of step 5b, each Annex B constraint and each query binding name (cases mixed; xslt4 and xpath4 read; xquery3 and an unknown name refused with exit status 1) is among them, reports and SVRL (active-group, severity, visit-each, schematronEdition) included. The driver keeps a list of deliberate deviations, each with its record: edition-other-value ( 8b, best-effort validation of other editions) and the cases that depend on reading the xslt binding and relative xpath contexts as sxml does (, ); a deviation outside that list is a failure. 6b. Expression rule contexts: 7.30's cases whose rule contexts are expressions but not patterns ((//item)[1], ../x, under xpath and xslt bindings, with from and documents) pass; a context that is a pattern compiles as before (no global, no intersect).

Compile errors of XSLT: a stylesheet with errors in several declarations gives each through the sink, in C, sxml transform (one line each, exit 1) and JavaScript; the null sink gives the first as before; XT40 unchanged case by case.

Done when: the gates pass; the C, CLI and JavaScript APIs are tested end to end (text, JSON and SVRL; --schema with --schematron; exit statuses 0, 1 (an unsupported binding among them), 2, 3 and 4); the book chapter's examples match (tools/check-book-examples.sh); clang-tidy and the call-cycle check are clean; QT4 and XT40 unchanged; the sxml.wasm and CLI size budgets raised in the same change if needed (), with the growth reported.

body.p: Done 2026-10-28 (): steps 1 to 10. The suite passes 463 of 463 applicable normative cases with 3 listed deviations (edition-other-value, binding-xpath2-no-maps, error-context-is-expression); EN 16931 UBL 1,133 of 1,133, compile 0.53 s within the default step bound; the differential agrees on all four rule sets (CII and XRechnung patched); XT40 unchanged. Open, for the owner: the EN 16931 CII and XRechnung sources are not correct Schematron as read (, "Proposed"), so ctest runs the UBL unit tests only; the JavaScript additions are not built (no WASI SDK).
